title: qe-dv data-table
description: Root node of the datavis `data-table` primitive: a classed `div` carrying a typed, optionally re-sortable table as node properties, whose single child is the portable `table` node rendering exactly the same data. Contract version 1.0. Seven further invariants cannot be expressed in JSON Schema because they cross-reference values inside the instance; they are enforced by the plugin and listed in CONTRACT.md.

type.description: Always `div`. No custom node types: `myst-to-tex` silently drops a subtree it has no handler for.

class.description: Space-separated class tokens, exactly as the directive emits them: `qe-dv qe-dv-data-table` first, then any author or wrapper tokens, single-spaced, no duplicates.

contract.description: Contract version this node conforms to.

primitive.description: Primitive name, for consumers that dispatch on a property rather than a class selector.

columns.description: Column definitions in display order. Keys are unique. The ordinal column added by `rank` is not listed here.

rows.description: Rows in the emitted order. Row `i` holds exactly one cell per entry of `columns`, in the same order, and cell `j`'s `kind` equals `columns[j].type`.

sortable.description: True when a consumer should offer client-side re-sorting. A table with `sortable: false` carries no sortable columns, no `sort` and no `nulls`.

rank.description: True when the table carries a leading ordinal column labelled `#`, numbered 1..N over the emitted order and recomputed by a consumer after a re-sort.

children.description: Exactly one child: the portable `table` node. Its first row is the header row; body row `i` renders `rows[i]`.

inlineNode.description: The permitted inline subset inside a fallback cell — the family's allowed node types, narrowed to the ones that can appear inline. `myst-to-tex` has no handler for `grid`, `card` or a custom node type and drops the whole subtree silently while the build still exits 0, so a cell's content is held to types every export path handles.

tone.description: A presentation hint, never a colour and never a threshold. Absent means `neutral`.

column.description: One column definition. `align` is always written out, so a column and its `tableCell`s never disagree.

key.description: Stable identifier, unique within the table. The directive slugifies the header label; a wrapper sets it directly.

label.description: Header text, rendered verbatim in the header row.

type.description: The kind every cell in this column carries.

sortable.description: Whether a consumer may re-sort on this column. Only number, bar and fraction columns may be sortable in contract 1.0.

cell.description: One cell. The `kind` selects the shape, and equals its column's `type`.

textCell.description: A plain string cell. A null value renders as an em dash.

value.description: The cell's whole content as plain text; null when there is no value.

url.description: Link target. The plain rendering wraps the value in a `link`.

codeCell.description: An identifier rendered in the mono face: a rule id, a series or lecture name, a file path.

value.description: The identifier; null when there is none, which renders as a plain em dash rather than an empty code span.

url.description: Link target. The plain rendering wraps the `inlineCode` in a `link`.

numberCell.description: A measured value. Null means the measure does not apply and renders as an em dash.

strong.description: Render the value with added weight. Separate from tone, which carries no weight.

barCell.description: A value plotted against its column's `max`. Null renders as an em dash, like every other absent value, and a renderer draws an empty track behind it.

fractionCell.description: A count out of a total, rendered as a strong numerator, a slash and the denominator.

badgeCell.description: A short categorical word. The label is the datum; the tone only says how to colour it.

chipsCell.description: A short list of labels. An empty list renders as an em dash, never as an empty cell.

table.description: The portable fallback. mdast nodes carry engine-added keys such as `key` and `position`, so unknown properties are allowed here; the family's forbidden keys are named and closed off individually.

children.description: Exactly one header row — row 0, which the plugin checks because JSON Schema cannot pin a position on a variable-length array — followed by one body row per entry of `rows`. A row is all header cells or none: a row with a header cell in one column and plain cells in the rest satisfies neither branch. Every row, header included, has the same number of cells; `myst-to-typst` emits cells as one flat positional sequence with no row delimiter, so a short row shifts every later cell one column left for the rest of the table.

tableRow.description: One row of the fallback table. Every row carries the same number of cells as every other row, including the header row.

headerRow.description: Row 0: every cell carries `header: true`, and no other row carries a header cell anywhere.

bodyRow.description: A row after row 0: no cell in it is a header. `myst-to-tex` writes a `\hline` after every row whose first cell is a header, and its long-table path counts leading header rows to find the body, so a row header rules the table after every line and, once wrapped in a multipage container, empties the body entirely.

tableCell.description: A cell of the fallback table. `children` is never empty: a cell with nothing to say carries an em dash. A cell is a dumb inner node — it carries presentation and content only, never `contract`, `primitive` or a second copy of the cell object it renders.

headerCell.description: A cell of row 0. `header: true` is required on every one of them.

bodyCell.description: A cell of a body row. `header` is absent, or explicitly false; it is never true.

nullsPolicy.description: Where null values go when a consumer re-sorts, in both directions. Present exactly when `sortable` is true; contract 1.0 fixes it to `last`.

sortState.description: The key and direction the emitted rows are already ordered by, so the server-rendered view is correct with JavaScript disabled and a consumer can mark the active header. Present exactly when `sortable` is true.

key.description: The `key` of a column whose own `sortable` is true.

barMax.description: Full-scale value a bar is drawn against. Required on a bar column, forbidden on every other type.

decimals.description: Fixed decimal places in the plain rendering. Absent means the shortest exact form. Numeric columns only; never applied to a null.
